content:
Ravi (Growth): Heads-up: planning a compact launch mini-digest tied to the benchmark + webinar. Need a 3-email nurture for registrants and a parallel 2-email 'clickers' flow for people who drop off before signing. Goal is drive RSVP and heat up trial pipeline.
Tess L.: For registrants: email1=confirmation + calendar, email2=2-day highlights + snippet, email3=1hr before + ask for questions. Clickers: immediate reminder to finish sign-up, 48h highlight only.
Nora (Design): I'll create 2 hero variations: "data-first" visual and "human story" visual. Also need a tiny template for customers (Dedicated/Private) that swaps in case studies.
Ben (Analytics): Segmenting proposal: product-interest tag (text-gen vs embeddings), account-size (SMB, Mid, Enterprise), and engagement bucket (high: clicked CTA / visited pricing). We'll prioritize high-engage Enterprise + Dedicated customers for an additional concierge CTA.
Kai (CS): For customers with Dedicated/private deployments, add a PS: "Schedule a dedicated capacity consult" link. We'll route those clicks to AE queue.
Ravi (Growth): Subject tests: 1) "Sneak benchmark + 1 actionable chart" 2) "New benchmark: what your peers are shipping" 3) short: "Benchmark highlights". Preview text variants too.
Tess L.: Suggest timezone sends: pick 9:30 local for APAC, 10am for NAM, 11am CET. Avoid Mon mornings for enterprise cohort.
Ben (Analytics): KPIs: RSVP rate, click-to-RSVP, trial-start within 7 days. Bench targets: RSVP 14% high-engage, 6% mid, 2% low. We'll add a UTM template: utm_source=email&utm_campaign=mini_digest_launch_v1&utm_medium=drip.
Nora (Design): Will drop 3 alt header images and an AMP-lite RSVP button for mobile.
Ravi (Growth): Automation notes: create campaign 'mini_digest_launch_2026_v1'. Webhook when status -> 'rsvp' to /hooks/lead-routing. Ops: increment lead_score: click +2, rsvp +6, attend +15. No-show microflow: 1) on-demand recording within 24h, 2) 10-day follow-up with product highlights + CTA to trial.
Ben (Analytics): I'll set up a live dashboard and a post-send cohort export. Need test sends to internal seed list of 40: product, growth, sales, cs.
Kai (CS): I'll prepare the Dedicated customer CTA and AE routing doc.
Ravi (Growth): Owners: Ravi (campaign lead), Tess (copy + cadence), Nora (creative), Ben (metrics), Kai (AE routing). Can we get final assets + test sends by Thursday EOD?
ops-bot: Ticket created MK-4991 -> campaign config & routing. https://app.redwood/boards/MK-4991 :white_check_mark:
Tess L.: :thumbsup: I'll post draft subjects + preview text in the doc by tomorrow.
